Franklin Navigator Growth Desk

Plan useful local outreach in English, Spanish or both directions without exporting raw contact lists or inferring language from names or protected characteristics.

See membershipBack to For Business

English → Spanish

Draft a Spanish-language version of member-approved public-business communication while preserving meaning and required disclaimers.

Spanish → English

Bilingual campaign mode

Prepare paired English and Spanish content so the member can choose the appropriate public-facing version at point of use.

Privacy and outreach boundaries

  • Eligible audiences come from public Franklin profiles and point-of-use public business contact routes.
  • No raw bulk email export.
  • No private resident data or another member's private data.
  • No language inference from surname, race, ethnicity, nationality, appearance or proxies.
  • Suppressions, opt-outs and frequency controls override campaign execution.

Current activation state

Planning preview: available.

Campaign execution: OFF. It remains locked until the secure member account, paid membership and opt-out systems are production-ready together.
